items.title: RJF Q3 deep dive: recruiting momentum and capital markets strength fuel results
items.summary: Financial services firm Raymond James Financial (NYSE:RJF) reported calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q4 2026) results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 14.5% year on year to $4.27 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.59 per share was 9.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
